rationale: Iteration 9's Evaluator approved an exact resubmission of the iteration 7 best (688.5), and that is the only design it approved. Its feedback says no model actions remain for a revision, so any change would be unreviewed and could not race. I therefore resubmit the approved design unchanged: kp 2.8, kd 0.9, ki 0, base_speed 1.1, sensor_weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], line_loss 'last_direction', sensor_size 0.012, and the iteration 4 spread (x = -0.024, -0.012, 0, 0.012, 0.024 m at y = 0.04 m). Body, wheel and mass values are unchanged. Evidence: this design gave oval 20/20, s-bend 20/20 and slalom 0/20 (max_error 0.0618, 1.05 line-loss events per run). Speed, spread, kd, kp and sensor_size have each been tested with the slalom max_error held between 0.061 and 0.064. Iteration 8 (sensor_size 0.016) and iteration 5 (wider spread) both lowered the score, so they are ruled out. Expected result: about 688 on the development tracks. The slalom is still the blocker. The hypotheses for the next iteration are that a forward sensor offset (y 0.04 to 0.06) or sensor_size 0.008 would sharpen slalom edge detection, and that ki or sensor_weights scale are untested. The requested measurements are slalom max_error and line_loss_events, which would show whether a new lever helps, plus s-bend and oval completion to confirm the baseline holds.
